name: Ecofriendly
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on August 16th, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 7 of the August 2020 Challenge B.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.

After the successful creation of the Nano paint, {GAME}'s engineers took the honeycomb grid technology a step further, replacing the robotic microcomponents with a living network of modified fern cells.
